description.value: Hertz has locations in Squamish, North Vancouver, Vancouver, Chilliwack, Nanaimo, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops (airport only, limited hours), and Cranbrook. The only major chain in BC that rents hitch-mounted bike racks (4-bike capacity) — availability varies by location. One-way rentals available between some locations; drop fee applies. Call to confirm vehicle type, bike rack availability, and one-way options before booking.

Exterior rack.detail: Hitch-mounted 4-bike rack; availability varies by location — call ahead to confirm
